images.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: full-width website footer background illustration, light theme.
Input images: Image 1 is a visual reference for scenery, characters, composition and rendering style, not a UI to reproduce.
Primary request: Create a clean artwork-only light-theme companion to the reference footer. A panoramic alpine lake valley framed by rocky cliffs and pine forests, layered distant peaks, foreground meadow with delicate pink and purple flowers. In the lower center a small fluffy lavender fox-like explorer with tall ears, cream head tuft and tail tip, wearing a brown backpack, sits on a rock with its back to the viewer; beside it to the right floats a small round friendly white robot with a dark face, warm smiling eyes, ear-like side fins and a thin luminous gold ring.
Style/medium: polished painterly fantasy game environment, soft detailed forms and tactile fur, matching the reference's illustrated quality.
Composition/framing: wide landscape approximately 16:9. Preserve the reference's valley perspective, lake on the right, foreground rock and two companions in the lower center. Upper 42 percent is mostly very pale warm ivory sky with a subtle pale blue tint and only faint sparse clouds, low contrast and usable behind dark HTML footer text. Keep scenery and characters predominantly in the bottom 58 percent. Make the upper sky naturally continuous, without a hard horizontal division.
Lighting/mood: peaceful early morning daylight, warm peach and golden sunlight illuminating cliff edges and fur, clear pale blue water, airy atmospheric distance.
Color palette: light ivory and pale sky blue above, fresh muted green meadow, peach-orange sunlight with restrained lavender shadows and pink flowers.
Constraints: artwork only, no text, letters, logo, navigation, icons, buttons, panels, borders or watermark. No new characters. No UI screenshot. Full bleed rectangular image.

Use case: lighting-weather
Asset type: full-width website footer background illustration, dark-theme twin of the supplied light-theme artwork.
Input images: Image 1 is the edit target. Preserve its exact composition and all geometry.
Primary request: Relight this exact scene into peaceful violet-blue night for a dark website theme. Change only lighting, colors, atmospheric conditions and sparse stars. Keep the exact same image dimensions, framing, horizon, mountain silhouettes, cliffs, pine trees, flower locations, lake shoreline, foreground rock, fox explorer and floating robot. Keep both companions identical in design, size, pose and exact position. Do not mirror, crop, shift, add or remove objects.
Lighting/mood: deep indigo-violet sky and cool lavender moonlight on rocks, fur, meadow and mountain peaks. The robot's existing golden eyes and halo give a small warm glow near the companions. A faint residual peach glow may remain at the far horizon but the image overall reads as night, not sunset. Lake reflections are cool blue-purple.
Composition/framing: the upper 42 percent stays quiet, smoothly dark indigo with only a few very faint tiny stars, usable behind pale HTML footer copy. No moon or bright celestial object in this reserved upper region. Scenery and characters stay in their existing places in the bottom of the image. Preserve fine detail in shadows without crushing everything to black.
Style/medium: retain exactly the original polished painterly fantasy game illustration and tactile fur, no change of style.
Constraints: artwork only, no text, letters, logo, navigation, icons, buttons, panels, borders or watermark. No extra characters. Maintain precise visual registration with the light-theme image.
